note: Manual owner overrides. 'overrides': rosters that changed hands mid-season (games in the listed weeks are credited to the listed manager id). 'season_owners': rosters whose Sleeper owner_id is wrong for the WHOLE season (Sleeper only stores a roster's current owner, so a roster handed to a new manager after the season shows the new manager for the old season). Both lists are applied by build_h2h.py, build_all_time_stats.py and apply_history_overrides.py (history.json). For season_owners every build swaps the roster's owner to sleeper_user_id for that season before anything is counted.

overrides.reason: Mike ran this roster Weeks 1-6 of 2024 and left the league at 11-1 (H2H plus median). League ruling (Jake Prosser, commissioner, Sep 2026): Week 7 onward, including the Week 7 0-2 (H2H loss plus median loss), belongs to Matt Z, the roster's Sleeper owner.
evidence: Commissioner ruling (Sep 2026): Mike left at 11-1, after Week 6; the Week 7 results are Matt Z's.
Roster 2 was 11-1 (H2H plus median) after Week 6 and 11-3 after Week 7.

Sleeper 2024 transactions: the 2024-10-19 trade with roster 8 (Matt F) was reversed by the commissioner on 2024-10-20 (see score_overrides.json). Matt Z's first move of his own was a waiver claim on Tue 2024-10-22.
Nothing Catchy Fantasy Football Podcast (Mike's show): the last episode, 'Week 7: Halfway to the Playoffs!', was published 2024-10-15.
overrides.history_json: apply_history_overrides.py splits history.json the same way (approved by Jake Prosser, commissioner, Oct 2026): Mike gets the 2024 Weeks 1-6 regular-season H2H W/L and PF and a 2024 season; Matt Z keeps Week 7 onward, the 2024 season, the playoff appearance and the finish (owner at season end).

season_owners.reason: Aaron Martinez managed 2024 roster 11 ('Team AMartinez', renamed 'Comrade Kamara') for the entire 2024 season (6-20, 4-9 H2H, missed playoffs) and then left the league. On 2024-12-31, after the season, the roster was handed to Matt Atkinson (Matt A), so Sleeper's 2024 league now lists matkinson94 as roster 11's owner. Matt A's first season was 2025 (roster 8 in the fresh 2025 league). The 2024 roster 11 season belongs to Aaron (Legacy Owner).
evidence: Sleeper 2024 transactions: every roster 11 move from 2024-09-02 through 2024-11-20 (15 waiver/FA moves plus 3 trades) was created by user 1135318402727460864 (amartinez528 / AMartinez528). matkinson94's only 2024 activity is 14 drops on 2024-12-31 between 10:18 and 10:20 MST, after the 2024 championship.
Nothing Catchy Podcast 2024-09-10 Power Rankings: 'Team A Martinez' ranked #1 (Kamara, Josh Allen, Waddle, Pittman, Ekeler roster = Sleeper 2024 roster 11).
